meta.title: Online Project Demo | Yopitek — Immersive Projection Showcase
meta.description: Explore Yopitek's 11 flagship projection mapping and immersive projection cases, including 2026 Taiwan Lantern Festival, C-LAB, King's Boat Museum, Banqiao Radio Station, and Lay's Cheese Waterfall.

hero.subtitle: Discover 11 selected immersive projection cases. From historical architectural facade mapping to 360° dome immersive environments, combining precise edge-blending calibration and real-time interactive sensing.

01.title: 2026 Taiwan Lantern Festival TechWorld
01.subtitle: Tech World Pavilion — Architectural & Indoor Cylinder Projection
01.description: The main show at the 2026 Taiwan Lantern Festival Tech World Pavilion is a multi-system integrated performance comprising projection mapping, stage lighting, acoustics, and new media interaction. In the center of the hall stands a massive cylindrical immersive projection screen showcasing dynamic visuals of blooming flora, vital rhythms, forests, and mountain ranges. Suspended wave-shaped drapes surround the top of the cylinder, through which moving stage lights project dynamic beams, color temperatures, and node transitions synchronized in real-time with the narrative arc. On the floor, moss and fern landscaping form layered flowerbeds housing hundreds of tablet computers—a digital flower sea technology co-developed by Yopitek and ITRI. Each tablet receives real-time cues to bloom synchronized digital blossoms that harmoniously echo the aerial floral projections above. Overcoming the core challenge of zero-latency synchronization among projection, stage lighting, sound, and the digital tablet flower field, Yopitek ensured flawless, stable operation throughout the extended run through rigorous systems integration and rehearsal calibration.

02.title: Taiwan Contemporary Culture Lab (C-LAB)
02.subtitle: FUTURE VISION LAB — Multi-Projector Dome Edge-Blending
02.description: Taiwan Contemporary Culture Lab (C-LAB) is Taiwan premier art-and-technology experimental incubator, transformed from historical architecture retaining exposed concrete beams and industrial lightwells. Yopitek was commissioned for the LED display integration project across C-LAB exhibition spaces, deploying multiple large-scale vertical flat LED display screens at key traffic nodes as dynamic carriers of the exhibition key visual identity: giant portrait LED walls flanking the lobby reception embrace the space, paired vertical LED screens at corridor entrances guide visitor flow, and a full-height vertical LED wall in the stairwell serves as an architectural visual anchor. All screens synchronously display cohesive visual themes with razor-sharp imagery and saturated colors, establishing a continuous digital frontage against the industrial heritage backdrop.

03.title: Donggang King's Boat Museum
03.subtitle: King's Boat Museum — Panoramic Immersive Projection Wall
03.client: Pingtung County King's Boat Cultural Museum
03.description: The Donggang King Boat Ceremony in Pingtung is one of Taiwan most iconic intangible cultural assets, recognized as a National Important Folk Custom. To convey this sacred heritage to contemporary audiences with modern technological grandeur, Yopitek was commissioned by the Pingtung King Boat Cultural Museum to design and engineer a massive panoramic curved immersive projection space. Using multiple high-lumen professional projectors calibrated with edge-blending technology, richly colored dynamic folklore illustrations are seamlessly mapped onto the expansive curved architectural wall, immersing visitors in an awe-inspiring visual journey where traditional faith is preserved through digital innovation.

04.title: 2026 Taiwan Floral Tech Expo
04.subtitle: Houbi Orchid Exhibition — 64m Ultra-Wide Curved Panoramic Projection
04.description: The Houbi Orchid Exhibition is one of Taiwan premier international floral expositions. Yopitek undertook the creation of the primary exhibition hall centerpiece immersive curved projection wall, stretching over 64 meters in an enveloping panoramic arc. Utilizing high-lumen professional projectors with precise edge-blending calibration, the display seamlessly renders tropical ecosystems, jungle pulses, and blooming floral spectacles. Integrated with suspended artist installations and calibrated ambient lighting, the pavilion transforms into a living botanical sanctuary, representing Yopitek largest curved projection installation to date.

05.title: Songshan Luminous Garden
05.subtitle: The LUMINOUS GARDEN — Baroque Garden Heritage Projection Mapping
05.description: The LUMINOUS GARDEN at Songshan Cultural and Creative Park is a flagship permanent nighttime multimedia spectacle. Yopitek was invited to create an immersive night garden projection theatre within the historic Baroque Garden. Utilizing the heritage tobacco factory facade as an expansive architectural projection canvas, high-precision geometric mapping and dynamic visuals blend 100-year-old architectural heritage with contemporary audio-visual theatrics. Overcoming outdoor natural light interference and multi-paneled window depths, Yopitek engineered a robust, long-running installation that revitalizes the cultural landmark and captivates international audiences nightly.

06.title: PALLADIUM Terminal
06.subtitle: PALLADIUM Terminal — 360° Sensory Immersive Experience
06.description: PALLADIUM, the heritage French functional footwear brand celebrated for urban exploration, hosted the "All-Terrain Terminal" brand experience at Taipei Zhongshan Linear Park in September 2026. Yopitek crafted a custom "360° Five-Senses Immersive Experience Zone", blending surround projection with dynamic lighting and an on-site 10-meter rainfall and mist installation. Multiple projectors were precisely edge-blended to generate a continuous 360-degree environment that brought the urban exploration spirit to life, powerfully conveying the brand message of the PALLADIUM × GORE-TEX® collection.

07.title: Banqiao Broadcasting Station
07.subtitle: Banqiao Broadcasting Station — 360° Full Immersive Projection Space
07.client: New Taipei City Cultural Affairs Department
07.description: Banqiao Broadcasting Station is Yopitek signature permanent cultural installation and one of the rare venues in Taiwan to achieve a complete 360° floor-and-wall immersive projection environment. Four perimeter walls and the entire floor surface are mapped with high-resolution imagery depicting enchanted forests, celestial light particles, and ecological spectacles. A hallmark feature is an interactive stage design accommodating live performers who dance within the moving visuals, uniting projection engineering with live performing arts in a benchmark installation that has operated continuously for years.

08.title: Lay's Flavor & Light Exhibition
08.subtitle: Lay's Cheese Waterfall — Real-time Fluid Interactive Projection
08.description: Lay Flavor Light and Shadow Exhibition was Taiwan groundbreaking snack-brand immersive experience at Huashan 1914 Creative Park. Yopitek developed the signature "Cheese Waterfall" interactive touch projection: visitors touching the cascading projection triggers real-time fluid simulation reactions, bridging visual and tactile senses for an unprecedented flavor journey that highlights Yopitek prowess in interactive projection systems.

09.title: Color Taipei City Hall Mapping
09.subtitle: Color Taipei — City Hall Dynamic Facade Projection Mapping
09.client: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism
09.description: Using the iconic facade of Taipei City Hall as a projection canvas, this installation celebrated the 2021 "Color Taipei" rainbow festivities, presenting dynamic architectural projection mapping that celebrated Taiwan diversity and pride. Yopitek overcame intricate geometric mapping challenges posed by colonnades, porticos, and recessed multi-layer window frames. Driving high-lumen engineering projectors with synchronized signal controls, the multi-night spectacle drew tens of thousands of citizens, earning widespread media coverage and establishing Yopitek as a benchmark partner in governmental architectural projection.

10.title: 2024 Asia-Pacific Sustainability Expo
10.subtitle: Rong Cheng Paper Industry — 4-Wall Panoramic Eco Exhibition
10.client: Rong Cheng Paper Industry Co., Ltd.
10.description: At Taipei World Trade Center Hall 1, Yopitek created a 4-wall panoramic immersive projection pavilion custom-engineered for Rong Cheng Paper Industry annual sustainability showcase. Synchronized projections across four walls depicted paper manufacturing workflows and low-carbon circular economy initiatives in seamless panoramic visuals. Visitors felt as if stepping onto the factory floor, experiencing firsthand the company commitment to environmental stewardship. Yopitek completed multi-projector geometric blending and AV synchronization within a strict setup window, earning high praise from visitors and media.

11.title: Jam Hsiao Art Exhibition
11.subtitle: Jam Hsiao Art Exhibition — Multi-Screen Framed Window Projection
11.description: Created for acclaimed musician Jam Hsiao, this intimate immersive solo exhibition revolves around music journeys, poetic metaphors, and Nordic natural landscapes. Short-throw overhead projectors transform all four gallery walls into simulated framed picture windows offering serene vistas of Nordic lakes and mountains. Blending live grand piano performances, rhythmic lighting control, and interactive staging, the installation delivers an exquisite fusion of music and visual poetry, demonstrating Yopitek artistic sensitivity and technical execution in high-end art exhibitions.
